head.name: head

params.name: title
params.description: Document title. Shown in the browser tab. Defaults to 'Ship View'.

head.description:
Emit the standard <head> contents for a view: meta tags, title, design
token CSS, Datastar, and the ship-elements bundle. In fragment mode
(loaded inside the shell via Datastar) these assets are already present,
so the macro emits nothing.
head.summary: Emit the standard <head> contents for a view: meta tags, title, design token CSS, Datastar, and the ship-elements bundle. In fragment mode (loaded inside the shell via Datastar) these assets are already present, so the macro emits nothing.

signal.name: signal

params.name: name
params.description: Signal name. Use a leading underscore (`_loading`, `_showForm`) for client-only state that should not round-trip to the server.

params.name: default
params.description: Initial value. String, number, boolean, `none`, or a JSON-like literal such as `{}` or `[]`. Defaults to the empty string.

signal.description:
Declare a reactive Datastar signal on the current element. String defaults
are emitted wrapped in single quotes, `none` becomes literal `null`, and
other types pass through unquoted so objects/arrays/numbers/booleans
serialize correctly.
signal.summary: Declare a reactive Datastar signal on the current element. String defaults are emitted wrapped in single quotes, `none` becomes literal `null`, and other types pass through unquoted so objects/arrays/numbers/booleans serialize correctly.

signals.name: signals

params.name: fields
params.description: mapping of signal name → default value.

signals.description:
Declare multiple Datastar signals at once with inferred types. Preferred
over repeated `signal()` calls when a view has more than two or three
signals: concise at the call site, and the type metadata it emits
(`data-ship-signal-types`) drives AST-lint's type-mismatch rule so a
later `$count = 'hello'` against a numeric signal is flagged.

Types are inferred from each default: strings → str, booleans → bool,
integers → int, other numbers → num, null → any, other → any.
signals.summary: Declare multiple Datastar signals at once with inferred types. Preferred over repeated `signal()` calls when a view has more than two or three signals: concise at the call site, and the type metadata it emits (`data-ship-signal-types`) drives AST-lint's type-mismatch rule so a later `$count = 'hello'` against a numeric signal is flagged.
signals.example:
<div {{ signals({'title': '', 'count': 0, 'active': false}) }}>

Emits (roughly):
  data-signals:title="''" data-signals:count="0" data-signals:active="false"
  data-ship-signal-types='{"title":"str","count":"int","active":"bool"}'

show.name: show

params.name: expr
params.description: Datastar expression (references signals with `$name`).

show.description:
Hide the element until the Datastar expression becomes truthy. Emits
`display:none` as an inline style so the element cannot flash into view
before Datastar hydrates.
show.summary: Hide the element until the Datastar expression becomes truthy. Emits `display:none` as an inline style so the element cannot flash into view before Datastar hydrates.

toggle_class.name: toggle_class

params.name: cls
params.description: Class name to add/remove.

params.name: expr
params.description: Datastar expression; class is present when truthy.

toggle_class.description: Reactively toggle a single CSS class based on a Datastar expression.
toggle_class.summary: Reactively toggle a single CSS class based on a Datastar expression.

attr.name: attr

params.name: name
params.description: Attribute name (e.g. `selected`, `disabled`, `aria-pressed`).

params.name: expr
params.description: Datastar expression producing the attribute value.

attr.description: Reactively bind an HTML attribute's value to a Datastar expression.
attr.summary: Reactively bind an HTML attribute's value to a Datastar expression.

live.name: live

params.name: view_name
params.description: View slug registered with the daemon. Resolves to `/api/runtime/view/<view_name>/sse`.

live.description:
Subscribe the current element to a view's long-lived SSE stream on
connect. The daemon pushes `datastar-patch-elements` frames that replace
marked regions whenever the view's declared kernel events fire.
live.summary: Subscribe the current element to a view's long-lived SSE stream on connect. The daemon pushes `datastar-patch-elements` frames that replace marked regions whenever the view's declared kernel events fire.

live_topic.name: live_topic
live_topic.description:
Subscribe to a filtered slice of the kernel event stream and merge the
payloads into a Datastar signal. Unlike `live()` which refreshes the
whole view via SSE morph, this primitive streams raw events into a
signal for client-side rendering.
live_topic.summary: Subscribe to a filtered slice of the kernel event stream and merge the payloads into a Datastar signal. Unlike `live()` which refreshes the whole view via SSE morph, this primitive streams raw events into a signal for client-side rendering.

loading.name: loading

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Signal that will flip to `true` while the fetch is in flight. Conventionally underscore-prefixed (`_creating`).

loading.description:
Mark the element as a Datastar action trigger whose in-flight state
writes a boolean to the given signal. Pair with `spinner()` or
`show()` to render a visual indicator.
loading.summary: Mark the element as a Datastar action trigger whose in-flight state writes a boolean to the given signal. Pair with `spinner()` or `show()` to render a visual indicator.

spinner.name: spinner

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Signal the spinner watches. Same value passed to `loading()`.

spinner.description:
Render an inline spinner that is visible while the given signal is
truthy. Designed to sit next to a button that uses `loading()` on the
same signal.
spinner.summary: Render an inline spinner that is visible while the given signal is truthy. Designed to sit next to a button that uses `loading()` on the same signal.

create.name: create

params.name: collection
params.description: Collection id (matches a schema in `.ship/collections/`).

params.name: data
params.description: Datastar expression whose value becomes the item's `data` payload.

create.description:
Wire a click handler that POSTs a new item into a collection. The
payload's `data` field is a Datastar expression — typically a form
signal such as `$form`.
create.summary: Wire a click handler that POSTs a new item into a collection. The payload's `data` field is a Datastar expression — typically a form signal such as `$form`.

update.name: update

params.name: collection
params.description: Collection id.

params.name: id
params.description: Target item id.

params.name: data
params.description: Datastar expression for the new `data` payload.

update.description:
Wire a click handler that PUTs updated data onto a specific collection
item.
update.summary: Wire a click handler that PUTs updated data onto a specific collection item.

delete.name: delete

params.name: collection
params.description: Collection id.

params.name: id
params.description: Item id to delete.

delete.description:
Wire a click handler that DELETEs a specific collection item. Does not
prompt — use `confirm_delete()` when a confirmation step is required.
delete.summary: Wire a click handler that DELETEs a specific collection item. Does not prompt — use `confirm_delete()` when a confirmation step is required.

navigate.name: navigate

params.name: url
params.description: URL to GET (typically under `/api/runtime/view/...`).

navigate.description:
Wire a click handler that fetches another view via Datastar `@get`,
triggering an in-page morph. Use this for partial updates within the
current view. For full shell-level routing use `nav()` or `view()`.
navigate.summary: Wire a click handler that fetches another view via Datastar `@get`, triggering an in-page morph. Use this for partial updates within the current view. For full shell-level routing use `nav()` or `view()`.

nav.name: nav

params.name: path
params.description: Shell path to navigate to (e.g. `/agents`).

nav.description:
Wire a click handler that navigates via the shell router when present,
falling back to a full page load. Use this for shell-level navigation.
nav.summary: Wire a click handler that navigates via the shell router when present, falling back to a full page load. Use this for shell-level navigation.

view.name: view

params.name: name
params.description: View slug. Becomes the path `/<name>`.

view.description:
Wire a click handler that navigates to a named view via the shell router
when present, falling back to a full page load at `/<name>`.
view.summary: Wire a click handler that navigates to a named view via the shell router when present, falling back to a full page load at `/<name>`.

on.name: on

params.name: event
params.description: Event name. Prefix is not required (no `on`).

params.name: expr
params.description: Datastar expression to run when the event fires. `evt` is in scope.

on.description:
Generic event-listener binding. Use for ship-element custom events
(`ship-change`, `ship-select`, etc.) and any DOM event not covered by
the action-specific macros.
on.summary: Generic event-listener binding. Use for ship-element custom events (`ship-change`, `ship-select`, etc.) and any DOM event not covered by the action-specific macros.

get.name: get

params.name: url
params.description: Fully-qualified path to GET.

get.description: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@get` to the given URL.
get.summary: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@get` to the given URL.

post.name: post

params.name: url
params.description: Target URL.

params.name: payload
params.description: Datastar expression (or JSON literal) passed as the request body. Defaults to an empty object.

post.description:
Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@post` to the given URL
with the supplied payload expression.
post.summary: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@post` to the given URL with the supplied payload expression.

put.name: put

params.name: url
params.description: Target URL.

params.name: payload
params.description: Request body expression. Defaults to an empty object.

put.description: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@put`.
put.summary: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@put`.

put_on_change.name: put_on_change

params.name: url
params.description: Target URL.

params.name: payload
params.description: Request body expression. Defaults to an empty object.

put_on_change.description:
Wire a change-event handler (fires on every committed input change)
that issues a Datastar `@put`. Good for settings inputs that persist
on change without an explicit save button.
put_on_change.summary: Wire a change-event handler (fires on every committed input change) that issues a Datastar `@put`. Good for settings inputs that persist on change without an explicit save button.

submit.name: submit

params.name: url
params.description: Target URL.

params.name: payload
params.description: Request body expression. Defaults to an empty object.

submit.description: Wire a form `submit` handler that POSTs the given payload.
submit.summary: Wire a form `submit` handler that POSTs the given payload.

bind.name: bind

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Signal to bind. Dotted paths (`form.title`) are supported when the parent signal is an object.

bind.description: Two-way-bind an input element's value to a Datastar signal.
bind.summary: Two-way-bind an input element's value to a Datastar signal.

create_job.name: create_job

params.name: agent_expr
params.description: Datastar expression producing the agent slug (e.g. `$selectedAgent`).

params.name: pipeline
params.description: Optional pipeline name. When truthy it is inlined into the request body. Defaults to the empty string (omitted).

create_job.description:
Wire a click handler that POSTs a new job to the runtime. The agent is
passed as a Datastar expression so UI state (a select value, signal,
etc.) can drive it. When `pipeline` is supplied it is added to the
payload verbatim.
create_job.summary: Wire a click handler that POSTs a new job to the runtime. The agent is passed as a Datastar expression so UI state (a select value, signal, etc.) can drive it. When `pipeline` is supplied it is added to the payload verbatim.

emit.name: emit

params.name: event_type
params.description: Kernel event type (e.g. `task.requested`).

params.name: data_expr
params.description: Datastar expression for the event's `data` payload. Defaults to an empty object.

emit.description:
Wire a click handler that posts a kernel event via `/api/events/emit`.
Use to trigger backend side-effects that other views listen to over SSE.
emit.summary: Wire a click handler that posts a kernel event via `/api/events/emit`. Use to trigger backend side-effects that other views listen to over SSE.

feedback.name: feedback

params.name: payload_expr
params.description: Datastar/JS object expression that becomes the feedback `payload`.

feedback.description:
Wire a click handler that posts structured feedback to the active
agent/session. The payload shape is whatever the agent designed — the
receiving prompt reads it. Use this when an agent-authored view needs
typed human input beyond free-text (ratings, selections, pick-one).

Emits as feedback (kind=action) so it flows through the
studio.feedback.created pipeline. The agent reads `payload` on the
event to see what the user picked.
feedback.summary: Wire a click handler that posts structured feedback to the active agent/session. The payload shape is whatever the agent designed — the receiving prompt reads it. Use this when an agent-authored view needs typed human input beyond free-text (ratings, selections, pick-one).

tab.name: tab

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Signal that tracks the active tab value.

params.name: value
params.description: The string value this tab represents.

params.name: label
params.description: Accepted for call-site readability; currently unused by the emitted attributes. Defaults to the empty string.

tab.description:
Wire a tab button. Sets the named signal to `value` on click and
exposes `aria-selected` reactively so CSS can style the active tab.
tab.summary: Wire a tab button. Sets the named signal to `value` on click and exposes `aria-selected` reactively so CSS can style the active tab.

tab_panel.name: tab_panel

params.name: signal_name
params.description: The same signal used with `tab()`.

params.name: value
params.description: The value this panel is visible for.

tab_panel.description:
Show the tab panel only when the tab signal matches `value`. Uses
`display:none` as a base style so panels don't flash before Datastar
hydrates.
tab_panel.summary: Show the tab panel only when the tab signal matches `value`. Uses `display:none` as a base style so panels don't flash before Datastar hydrates.

chip.name: chip

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Filter signal.

params.name: value
params.description: Value this chip selects.

params.name: view_name
params.description: When set, a `@get('/api/runtime/view/<view_name>/sse')` is appended to refresh results. Defaults to the empty string (client-only filter).

chip.description:
Wire a filter chip: on click, sets the named signal to `value` and
(optionally) refreshes the view's SSE stream so the server reruns the
query with the new filter. Also exposes `selected` reactively for the
active chip.
chip.summary: Wire a filter chip: on click, sets the named signal to `value` and (optionally) refreshes the view's SSE stream so the server reruns the query with the new filter. Also exposes `selected` reactively for the active chip.

chip_all.name: chip_all

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Filter signal to clear.

params.name: view_name
params.description: When set, refreshes `/api/runtime/view/<view_name>/sse` after clearing.

chip_all.description:
A companion to `chip()` that clears the filter (sets the signal to the
empty string) and optionally refreshes SSE. Use for an "All" chip next
to value-specific chips.
chip_all.summary: A companion to `chip()` that clears the filter (sets the signal to the empty string) and optionally refreshes SSE. Use for an "All" chip next to value-specific chips.

search.name: search

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Query signal (bound with `data-bind`).

params.name: view_name
params.description: View whose SSE stream to refresh on input.

params.name: delay
params.description: Datastar debounce modifier (e.g. `300ms`, `500ms`). Defaults to `300ms`.

search.description:
Wire a debounced search input: two-way-binds to a signal and refreshes
the view's SSE stream when the user pauses typing.
search.summary: Wire a debounced search input: two-way-binds to a signal and refreshes the view's SSE stream when the user pauses typing.

on_change_debounced.name: on_change_debounced

params.name: expr
params.description: Datastar expression.

params.name: delay
params.description: Debounce duration. Defaults to `300ms`.

on_change_debounced.description:
Run an expression on `change`, debounced. Useful for settings that
auto-save after the user finishes editing.
on_change_debounced.summary: Run an expression on `change`, debounced. Useful for settings that auto-save after the user finishes editing.

radio.name: radio

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Selection signal.

params.name: value
params.description: Value this option represents.

radio.description:
Wire a radio-style button: sets the named signal to `value` on click
and reflects the selection via `aria-checked`.
radio.summary: Wire a radio-style button: sets the named signal to `value` on click and reflects the selection via `aria-checked`.

confirm_delete.name: confirm_delete

params.name: collection
params.description: Collection id.

params.name: id
params.description: Item id to delete.

confirm_delete.description:
Wire a click handler that shows a browser `confirm()` dialog with
"Delete this item?" and, on OK, DELETEs the item. For a typed
Ship-styled confirm dialog use `confirm_dialog()` / `confirm_trigger()`.
confirm_delete.summary: Wire a click handler that shows a browser `confirm()` dialog with "Delete this item?" and, on OK, DELETEs the item. For a typed Ship-styled confirm dialog use `confirm_dialog()` / `confirm_trigger()`.

confirm.name: confirm

params.name: message
params.description: Dialog text.

params.name: action_expr
params.description: Datastar expression to run when the user confirms.

confirm.description:
Wire a click handler that shows a browser `confirm()` dialog with the
given message and, on OK, runs the Datastar expression.
confirm.summary: Wire a click handler that shows a browser `confirm()` dialog with the given message and, on OK, runs the Datastar expression.

live_persistent.name: live_persistent

params.name: view_name
params.description: View slug whose SSE stream to subscribe to.

live_persistent.description:
Like `live()`, but configures Datastar with `requestCancellation: 'disabled'`
so the SSE connection is not aborted when other `@get`/`@post` actions
fire on the page. Use for views that must stay subscribed across
navigations within the same shell region.
live_persistent.summary: Like `live()`, but configures Datastar with `requestCancellation: 'disabled'` so the SSE connection is not aborted when other `@get`/`@post` actions fire on the page. Use for views that must stay subscribed across navigations within the same shell region.

on_fetch_error.name: on_fetch_error

params.name: signal_name
params.description: Signal that receives the error message when the fetch fails.

params.name: message
params.description: JS expression producing the error message. Has access to `evt.detail.argsRaw.status`. Defaults to `'HTTP ' + status`.

on_fetch_error.description:
Bind a signal to receive a failure message when a fetch action on
THIS element returns an HTTP error or non-SSE body.

Datastar fires a `datastar-fetch` event on document with
  detail: { type: 'error', el: <trigger>, argsRaw: { status } }
when `onopen` sees a >= 400 response. This macro attaches a
document-level listener scoped to the current element so a failed
`@post`/`@get`/`@put`/`@delete` patches the named error signal.
on_fetch_error.summary: Bind a signal to receive a failure message when a fetch action on THIS element returns an HTTP error or non-SSE body.

form.name: form

params.name: schema
params.description: Collection schema (from `ship_schema(collection)`).

params.name: collection
params.description: Collection id. Kept for future extension and lint alignment.

params.name: form_signal
params.description: Parent signal object inputs bind into. Defaults to `form`.

form.description:
Auto-generate field inputs from a collection schema, two-way-bound to
$<form_signal>.<field>. For the full CRUD surface (submit, loading,
error surface, create vs update), pair this with explicit `create()`
or `update()` macros on a separate button — the deferred full-CRUD
primitive is tracked in docs/ship-sdk/references/docs/roadmap.md.

Field types: enum → <ship-select>, boolean → <ship-switch>, number →
numeric <ship-input>, markdown → <ship-textarea>, else <ship-input>.
Required fields render a red asterisk suffix.
form.summary: Auto-generate field inputs from a collection schema, two-way-bound to $<form_signal>.<field>. For the full CRUD surface (submit, loading, error surface, create vs update), pair this with explicit `create()` or `update()` macros on a separate button — the deferred full-CRUD primitive is tracked in docs/ship-sdk/references/docs/roadmap.md.

table.name: table

params.name: schema
params.description: Collection schema dict.

params.name: items
params.description: Iterable of item records with `.id`, `.data`, `.updated_at`.

params.name: collection
params.description: Collection id (used by the per-row delete button).

table.description:
Auto-generate a data table from a schema plus a list of items. Emits
an ID column, one column per schema field with type-appropriate
formatting (enum -> chip, boolean -> badge, number -> monospace,
array -> up-to-4 chips with overflow badge), an Updated column, and a
per-row delete button wired with `delete(collection, item.id)`.
table.summary: Auto-generate a data table from a schema plus a list of items. Emits an ID column, one column per schema field with type-appropriate formatting (enum -> chip, boolean -> badge, number -> monospace, array -> up-to-4 chips with overflow badge), an Updated column, and a per-row delete button wired with `delete(collection, item.id)`.

layout_center.name: layout_center

params.name: max_width
params.description: CSS length for the column's maximum width. Defaults to `768px`.

layout_center.description:
Open a centered single-column layout wrapper: `max-width` with
horizontal auto-margins and generous vertical padding (space-6 top,
space-12 bottom). Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for
settings pages, forms, and detail views.
layout_center.summary: Open a centered single-column layout wrapper: `max-width` with horizontal auto-margins and generous vertical padding (space-6 top, space-12 bottom). Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for settings pages, forms, and detail views.

layout_sidebar.name: layout_sidebar

params.name: sidebar_width
params.description: CSS length for the sidebar column. Defaults to `240px`.

layout_sidebar.description:
Open a two-column grid: fixed sidebar + flexible main pane, full
height. Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for explorers and
canvas-style views.
layout_sidebar.summary: Open a two-column grid: fixed sidebar + flexible main pane, full height. Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for explorers and canvas-style views.

layout_three_col.name: layout_three_col

params.name: left
params.description: CSS length for the left column. Defaults to `240px`.

params.name: right
params.description: CSS length for the right column. Defaults to `320px`.

layout_three_col.description:
Open a three-column grid: fixed left sidebar + flexible main pane +
fixed right info panel, full height. Must be closed with
`layout_end()`. Good for IDE-style views.
layout_three_col.summary: Open a three-column grid: fixed left sidebar + flexible main pane + fixed right info panel, full height. Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for IDE-style views.

layout_end.name: layout_end
layout_end.description:
Close a layout wrapper opened by `layout_center()`, `layout_sidebar()`,
or `layout_three_col()`.
layout_end.summary: Close a layout wrapper opened by `layout_center()`, `layout_sidebar()`, or `layout_three_col()`.

toast_container.name: toast_container
toast_container.description:
Mount the `<ship-toast-container>` in the bottom-right corner with the
id `ship-toasts`. `toast_action()` looks this up by id to dispatch
toasts. Place once per page.
toast_container.summary: Mount the `<ship-toast-container>` in the bottom-right corner with the id `ship-toasts`. `toast_action()` looks this up by id to dispatch toasts. Place once per page.

toast_action.name: toast_action

params.name: message
params.description: Toast title text.

params.name: tone
params.description: Visual tone — `default`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `destructive`. Defaults to `default`.

params.name: duration
params.description: Time in milliseconds before auto-dismiss. Defaults to `3000`.

toast_action.description:
Wire a click handler that dispatches a toast through the container
mounted by `toast_container()`.
toast_action.summary: Wire a click handler that dispatches a toast through the container mounted by `toast_container()`.

confirm_dialog.name: confirm_dialog

params.name: id
params.description: Unique id suffix. The dialog's DOM id becomes `confirm-<id>`.

params.name: title
params.description: Heading text.

params.name: description
params.description: Body text under the heading.

params.name: action_attrs
params.description: Pre-rendered attributes for the confirm button — typically a `delete()` / `post()` / `put()` macro call.

confirm_dialog.description:
Render a `<ship-alert-dialog>` that gates a destructive action.
Cancel closes the dialog; Confirm executes `action_attrs` and then
closes. Pair with `confirm_trigger(id)` on the opening button.
confirm_dialog.summary: Render a `<ship-alert-dialog>` that gates a destructive action. Cancel closes the dialog; Confirm executes `action_attrs` and then closes. Pair with `confirm_trigger(id)` on the opening button.

confirm_trigger.name: confirm_trigger

params.name: id
params.description: Matching id passed to `confirm_dialog()`.

confirm_trigger.description:
Wire a click handler that opens a `confirm_dialog()` by id (adds the
`open` attribute to `confirm-<id>`).
confirm_trigger.summary: Wire a click handler that opens a `confirm_dialog()` by id (adds the `open` attribute to `confirm-<id>`).

section.name: section

params.name: title
params.description: Section heading text. Required.

params.name: icon
params.description: ship-icon registry name (e.g. `activity`, `cpu`). Optional.

params.name: link_href
params.description: URL for the trailing pill. Optional.

params.name: link_label
params.description: Visible text on the trailing pill. Optional.

section.description:
Open a `<ship-card>` with a standardized slot-header row: optional
leading ship-icon + title on the left, optional trailing link pill
(muted text + right-chevron) on the right. Must be paired with
`endsection()`.

When `link_href` starts with `/api/runtime/view/`, the trailing link
is wired to `@get(link_href)` with `.prevent` so SSE-aware navigation
takes over. Otherwise it is a plain anchor.

The layout is inline-styled on purpose — the macro owns the
standardized design tokens so view authors don't have to re-declare
`.dash-section-head`.
section.summary: Open a `<ship-card>` with a standardized slot-header row: optional leading ship-icon + title on the left, optional trailing link pill (muted text + right-chevron) on the right. Must be paired with `endsection()`.

styles.name: styles
styles.description:
Emit the shared `<style>` block used by `form()` and `table()`:
`.ship-form-field`, `.ship-form-label`, `.ship-table`, `.mono`,
`.muted`, `.null`. Place once in `<head>` when a view renders an
auto-form or auto-table.
styles.summary: Emit the shared `<style>` block used by `form()` and `table()`: `.ship-form-field`, `.ship-form-label`, `.ship-table`, `.mono`, `.muted`, `.null`. Place once in `<head>` when a view renders an auto-form or auto-table.
